g.text: Nearby — Code Structure (src/infra/): implementations bound in InfraModule (API process)
core: repositories and adapters (methods on code-structure-core-*)
ESLint rejects any other import across these boxes
Implementations have the methods of the abstract class they implement
Grey boxes: abstract classes of core, with their methods on code-structure-core-*
The import process binds its own: see code-structure-import
